response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a strong individual-contributor software engineer with broad technical range (backend, mobile, embedded, DLang, distributed systems) but has never held a leadership, management, or executive title, and shows no track record of scaling or leading engineering organizations. His AI-agent exposure is limited to recent, vague 'contributions' to MCP tooling rather than production multi-agent system ownership, and there is no evidence of fintech credit-risk, regulatory, or compliance system experience. The gap between this profile and the CTO-level requirements (10+ years with 5+ in senior leadership, team scaling 10-30+, production multi-agent AI in regulated finance) is too large to justify an interview for this role.
strengths: Deep, versatile hands-on engineering skills across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Demonstrated craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, workshops/mentoring)
Some exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP tooling) and fintech-adjacent companies (RIDE Capital, Optilyz)
concerns: No leadership or management titles/history — entire career is individual contributor, not executive or team-lead track
No evidence of scaling engineering teams, managing senior leaders, or governing outsourced/hybrid engineering models
Minimal, recent, and vague multi-agent AI production experience; no regulated/high-stakes fintech credit or compliance system experience

key_factors.factor: Insufficient production multi-agent AI and regulated fintech experience
Strong general technical breadth and craftsmanship
